points.text: Finished task hub-vendor-stall: Vendor stall geometry, collision, sticks.
Finished task hub-draw-order: Hub draw-order / sorting sweep.
Finished task hub-ground-roofs: Ground transitions + roof UV / awning banding.
Finished task hub-bake-lights: Hub bake, prop shadows, lamps, light leaks, desktop shading.
Specials now cost half the mana (40 to 20) and take 1.5 times as long to recover (1.0 s to 1.5 s), for every weapon. Saves get the new values.
Saves no longer store balance numbers: game updates always use the shipped values, and balance values edited into a save reset to them.

New Report Bug page in Pause > Settings, in every build: pick an area and what happened (no typing needed on a gamepad), add details, a screenshot and an optional private email, and the report goes straight to the developer. After a crash it can attach that session's log.
Camp: the vendor stall's front no longer flickers against its painted face, and its side and back walls now show lit timber planks like the other buildings.
Camp: the reception lantern now hangs visibly from the awning beside the window with its glow on it, instead of a smudge on the awning.
The sword swing line no longer draws through the vendor stall's walls.

entries.summary: Finished task hub-vendor-stall: Vendor stall geometry, collision, sticks.

Posts thickened and right wall + full front-face collision added so bake shadows and blocking match the other walls.
web-session.md: removed resume-line assumption for web-owned parked tasks.
hub-vendor-stall: front collision fixed; posts visible but still misaligned to face edges; tarp occlusion vs player still open; right-wall mesh and bake stamp experiments landed locally (not closed).

entries.summary: Stall geometry, collision, and sorting fixed; web task flow clarified.

Tool checkers default to changed files, run in parallel, and compile-check each tool

entries.summary: Archives pin the right commits and the tool checker is faster.

points.text: Clarified changelog protocol: bullets record outcomes (not intermediate debugging), and the Summary must cover every bullet in the file.
Distributed additional hub screenshots into the task refs folders and updated each task's Refs section to name the files that are actually present and what they show.

entries.summary: Aligned hub task refs with the actual screenshots and updated the task descriptions to match.

points.text: Clarified changelog Summary rule: each file's Summary covers every bullet in it; intermediate emits update it; a push starts the next label fresh.

grok_share.py: Playwright tool that loads Grok shares (default dedicated Edge profile), dumps the conversation, and lists/saves images (User attachments and Grok-generated mediaId assets rewritten to public grok-img-share URLs).
Staged the original 9 hub screenshots and distributed them into the per-task refs folders; added the current receptionist source plate to hub-guild-reception.
task_lib.done now deletes design/refs/<id>/ when a task is marked done; removed orphaned refs folders.
Web tasks are started by naming the task in a web session (no open_slice resume); open_slice remains the User start command for Build tasks only.

entries.summary: Added grok_share.py for pulling Grok share conversations and images, clarified web-session changelog and task-start rules, and cleaned up refs handling so finished tasks remove their reference images.

points.text: Clarified protocol so web/chat sessions clearly can run full hub bake + stamp, shots, Godot import checks, and non-tiled asset processing by calling any tools/ script from the scratch.

Created web tasks hub-vendor-stall, hub-guild-reception (folds receptionist-redesign), hub-draw-order, hub-ground-roofs, and hub-bake-lights; added empty design/refs/<task>/ folders; pointed the old Build receptionist-redesign task at the web fold-in.
Added tools/grok_share.py: Playwright-based extractor for Grok share links (conversation dump + image download into refs or _src).
grok_share.py now tags images by turn and attachment index so specific screenshots can be saved to different task refs or _src.

entries.summary: Clarified web/chat protocol for full bake, shots, and non-tiled assets via scratch; created five hub web tasks (vendor stall, guild reception with receptionist redesign fold-in, draw-order, ground/roofs, bake/lights) plus refs folders; added tools/grok_share.py (Playwright) with turn/index image selection for pulling share assets into the repo.

points.text: Quest board uses pinned posters. Pause gained a Quest tab between Inventory and Skills. Taking an offer lifts its poster into the tab; cancel or complete rolls new ones.
Death recap uses the Skills journal layout: two paper sheets, XP columns and drain on the wide sheet, skill tip on the narrow one.
Receptionist Talk and Ask? replace the old guild task list. Talk has a once-only first line then a rotating line; Ask? opens How-to-Play pages with baked screenshots.

Crystal loadout and other code-drawn UI are moving to generated PNG art. New crystal frame work landed, UI style is locked in ui-style.md, mockups exist for the major screens, and isolated media has a generic UI kind.
Receptionist redesign started: the bust is a clipped version of the existing sprite, with the young goth/metal guild-clerk design and NPC rekey recipe ready. Talk portraits can follow the same look.
Ground wear is now a small baked tileable sheet sampled once, instead of a runtime hash. Web and desktop shade the same cells.

Global rekey was rebuilt (clean plate, trimap, one alpha solve) and preserves pixel-art interiors past a glow-aware edge band. Tree, slot, vendor crate/pot, and arrow art were re-baked. Bibles were locked.
Welcome banner text is restored and centered on the cloth via an overlay.
Recap Continue button keeps its glyph and label as one group and dims correctly while XP drains. The footer chip is hidden.

Gear tips step aside from open slot pickers so they no longer overlap the anvil. Pickers open beside their slot and stay on-screen. Camp HUD hides while camp menus are open. Vendor header shrinks to fit its board. Controls glyphs share one column.
Ghost shop shelf rows have a thicker gold focus ring. Scroll cues appear on clipped lists. Crystal focus is gold (no pink). Updates shows player notes only. Title disabled buttons stay readable.
Debug scripts stay out of release and web exports. Release smoke and the build gate run the stripped path. Root `_` folders are ignored; local exports go to `_out/web`.
Hub performance benches record real frame time, layer capture, and measurable done-when criteria. Desktop-release timing tools were added. The ending-fill hitch on web remains under investigation.
Isolated media tools gained aspect ratios, a real review gate, and NPC/UI kinds. Build-cycle docs, prove rules, unit queues, first-command path, and load-graph coverage were tightened.
Size splits, leak fixes, dead-code drops, and export hygiene landed so the next week starts from a cleaner tree.

entries.summary: Week 8 Grok Build snapshot. Quest board and Skills-journal recap, UI PNG art and receptionist redesign underway, rebuilt rekey and baked ground wear, recap/gear/HUD polish, cleaner debug/release separation, hub perf tooling, and tighter build process.
